title: Use an explicit rule
summary: A rule tells a program exactly what to do when a condition is met. Some AI systems include rules, while others learn patterns from data.
introduction: A rule tells a program exactly what to do when a condition is met. Some AI systems include rules, while others learn patterns from data. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question
